title: Aico context delivery
description: What `aico context deliver` (packages/context deliver()) returns. CLI: `aico context deliver --tool T --project P --session S [--role R] [--coordinator] [--event E] [--format text|json|claude|codex|pi] [--force]`. --tool is a Tether adapter id: claude-code, codex or pi (claude and claude_code mean claude-code). --project is the project id (falling back to $AICO_PROJECT_ID); omit it (or pass '') for a session outside any project, or pass one that is not in the project registry (project_permissions), which gets global context only and a 'project' entry in missing. In a claude or codex hook the text is also cut to the tool's hookBudgetBytes (data/delivery.json) where it has one. --session is the Aico session id (or the tool's own id when there is none); it only labels the inventory row. --role is the work role or Aico role (default: $ST_WORK_ROLE); --coordinator marks a coordinator session. --event names the hook event for the claude and codex envelopes (default SessionStart). Formats: text (default) prints the delivered text; json prints this object; claude and codex print the tool's hook stdout, {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":E,"additionalContext":TEXT}}; pi prints the text for Pi's system prompt. Already delivered: when $AICO_CONTEXT_DELIVERED is set and $AICO_CONTEXT_PID names the agent Tether launched, which must be this process's parent or one of the next data/delivery.json markerHops-1 parents above it (Tether wrote the delivery at launch: a CLAUDE.md dir for Claude Code, developer_instructions for Codex, --append-system-prompt for Pi; a session that agent starts in turn inherits the variables but not the pid, so it gets its own delivery) or $AGENT_HUB_CONTEXT_PREINJECTED_HASH is set (Agent Hub's launcher delivered), the claude, codex and pi formats print nothing and exit 0, so a hook never adds a second copy; --force prints anyway; text and json always print. Exit: 0 delivered (or nothing to add), 1 failed (one line on stderr naming why: the hook should say so plainly in the tool's output), 2 usage error. Claude Code keeps hook context over 10,000 characters as a file plus a short preview, so Tether-launched Claude sessions get the CLAUDE.md dir and the hook path is only for Claude sessions started outside Tether.

over.description: True when the sections that are never cut (guardrails, mandates) alone exceed the budget.

sections.description: The delivered sections in order; text is their bodies joined by one blank line.

cut.description: Sections the budget removed, in the order it removed them.

missing.description: Sections that should be there but whose source failed (tool usage command, session list): the reason, never an empty section.

kind.description: Render order is the enum order (authority first). The budget cuts sections in the order packages/context/data/delivery.json cutOrder lists, the last section of a kind first; guardrail and mandate are never cut.

items.description: What the section holds: a prompt slug, memory ids, or the computed source.
